name: Starbright Agency
summary:
In the neon-lit streets of Neo Seattle, being a hero isn’t just a calling — it’s a high-stakes industry. Unranked and overlooked, Star Scout Wishbright would do anything to get her big break until her agency proposes a bold plan: Fake a high-profile romance with one of the city’s top-ranked Scouts to skyrocket her to success.

Staged dates, exciting twists and turns. It’s all for show — until the spotlight reveals truths Wishbright could never expect.

Neo Seattle’s finest, not unlike the city itself, are full of secrets. Secrets hidden in their civilian lives — where the masks come off and identities are not just for show. Can Wishbright navigate the act and the actual without losing herself?

In the end, will she choose fame, love, or something gray in between? Set against a glittering City-Pop inspired backdrop this queer friendly visual novel puts you in control of Wishbright’s journey through love and heartbreak, fame and failure.

Will you rise to the top? Or will you realize that some dreams aren’t worth losing yourself over.
